scene: The thumping jukebox triggers wall panels to reveal three quirky transit exits.
picture: A flat side view along the opened diner wall. Far left sits a glowing rooftop escalator leading up. Left, the player in red bomber jacket and roller skates taps her foot. Centre waits an open noodle-cart monorail cabin. Right, the glowing jukebox plays tunes. Far right, an open bamboo cable car dangles patiently.
shown: a glowing neon escalator ascending upwards, located on the far left
a steaming giant noodle bowl monorail car waiting at centre
a green bamboo cable car suspended from a wire, on the far right
